name: Mounting Olympus
source:
Set in Ancient Greece, you go on an adventure, meet goddesses, and bang them in lovingly hand-illustrated scenes.

[From [url=https://ratatooey.itch.io/mounting-olympus]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
故事以古希腊为舞台，你将踏上一场冒险之旅，邂逅众位女神，并在精美的纯手绘场景中与她们尽享云雨之欢。

[摘自[url=https://ratatooey.itch.io/mounting-olympus]itch.io[/url]]
